## Checklist

- [ ] Linked issue (or a sentence explaining why none applies)
- [ ] Tests added/updated (`pytest`, golden cases where applicable)
- [ ] `make build && make test` green (`make smoke` too if install paths changed)
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md` / `CONTRIBUTING.md`; `AGENTS.md` and `dist/`
      regenerate via `make build` — never hand-edited) if behavior changed
- [ ] Branch follows the naming standard
      (`feature/…`, `fix/…`, `hotfix/…`, `chore/…`, `docs/…`, `release/…`
      — see `CONTRIBUTING.md`)
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, …)
